How to Create a User in Bearmail

Create a mailbox user through the Stalwart web admin panel. The example below creates west@bearos.si.

Step 1: Open the Accounts page

In the Stalwart admin panel, go to Directory → Accounts. You will see the existing accounts, for example luoxi@bearos.si and admin@bearos.si.

Step 2: Start creating the user

Click Create user (top right). Leave Account type as User account.

Step 3: Enter the username

In Username, type the local part of the address, for example west.

Step 4: Pick the domain

In Domain, choose the domain from the dropdown, for example bearos.si. The full address becomes west@bearos.si. Full Name and Tenant are optional.

Step 5: Add a credential

Scroll down to Authentication → Credentials and click Add item. Set the credential type to Password for authenticating to the account.

Step 6: Set the password

Enter the secret in Secret value of the account (stored masked). OTP Authentication URI and Expiration Date are optional.

Step 7: Confirm roles

Under Groups & Roles, Roles defaults to User role and Permissions to Inherited permissions. Leave these as-is for a normal mailbox user.

Step 8: Review locale and encryption, then create

Locale defaults to English locale for the USA; Time Zone is optional. Encryption at Rest is Disabled. Click Create (bottom right).

Step 9: Done

A Created successfully notice appears and the new address, for example west@bearos.si, shows up in the Accounts list.

Next step for AI agents: the login password is for humans (WebUI/IMAP). To let an AI agent use the new mailbox over MCP, issue a Stalwart API key for the account instead — see the Bearmail agent guide.
